alexa (Marketing): Heads up — we're ready to push a microcopy A/B for the Pricing page and a webinar CTA tweak today. Need a last pass on FAQ language and inbound lead routing. @mike can you own the HubSpot mapping?

mike (Growth): On it. Which CTA variant are we wiring to the webinar slide/registration form?

alexa (Marketing): Use Variant B on the webinar (label: 'Reserve capacity'). Site A/B will compare 'Reserve capacity' vs 'Try hosted'. Analytics event names I want: `pricing_experiment_variant` and `lead_source=webinar_microsnippet`.

ben (Analytics): I'll wire those. Final events I'll add: `pricing_page_experiment_v2`, `lead_routing=marketing_webinar_v2`. Also add a `tier_label` property so we can segment conversions by tier naming.

tess (Content): Draft FAQ tweak: Q: "How do Dedicated and Private differ from Hosted?" A: "Dedicated = reserved capacity for predictable throughput; Private = customer-managed networking and optional air-gapped deployments." Also recommend one-line callouts under each tier: e.g., 'Reserved for steady production' (Dedicated) and 'For regulated or offline environments' (Private).

sanjay (Product): Heads-up from legal/product: avoid the term 'Committed' on public pages — it implies billing commitments. Let's standardize on 'Reserved' across content and the copy variants.

alexa (Marketing): Good catch, switching to 'Reserved' everywhere. Also need the exact inbound routing rules. Proposed mapping:
```
if lead.source contains "webinar_microsnippet":
  if lead.enterprise_interest == true -> assign AE queue
  else if lead.region == "EMEA" -> assign sdr-emea
  else -> assign sdr-na
tags: pricing_snippet, webinar_nudge
```
Can you add that to the HubSpot workflow, @mike? Also add utm=cta_variant on the webinar registration links.

mike (Growth): Will add the workflow and utm param. Quick Q: do we want click-tracking for 'Reserve capacity' vs 'Try hosted' too? I can pass the CTA clicks as `cta_variant` in events.

ben (Analytics): Yes — capture `utm_param=cta_variant` and `event: pricing_cta_click`. I'll create a dashboard for conversion by variant and by `tier_label`. Recommend a 2-hour progressive rollout with a CMS kill-switch flag `pricing_copy_blackout` so we can revert quickly.

alexa (Marketing): Checklist then: 1) update FAQ language, 2) replace 'Committed' -> 'Reserved', 3) deploy A/B copy, 4) add analytics events/tags, 5) add utm/cta tracking, 6) create HubSpot workflow mapping, 7) update webinar slide CTA to Variant B. Ping me when live. :rocket: 

deploy-bot: deploy started: pricing-copy-rollout (id: pr-20240322-19)

tess (Content): Deployed copy and smoke-tested links — found one tiny typo in FAQ, fixed it. All CTA links include utm=cta_variant now.

deploy-bot: deploy success: pricing-copy-rollout completed at 1777777789

alexa (Marketing): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short postmortem next week with early metrics.
